items.html: Indeed, the light that was at first below and rose upward remained thereafter always above, at the Chazeh, and did not descend through the Parsa. However, since they are there above and are pressed there, they brought out branches outward through the Einayim; and these are the Nekudim, which expanded outside AK, from the Tabur to the end of the feet. (23) And this is their essence. Yet that new light too, which descended into his internality through the Parsa, it too (24) breaks through the vessel and the Guf of AK and shines into these Nekudim, (25) both through the hollows of the hair and through the Tabur and the Yesod. It turns out that this new light makes two breaches: one through the Parsa, and the second through the walls of the vessels of AK.
